steps.title: Подзапросы, UNION и иерархии
steps.content:
## Подзапросы и множества

- Коррелированный подзапрос считает условие «для каждой строки» (например, нет сотрудника с большей зарплатой в отделе).
- **`UNION`** убирает дубликаты, **`UNION ALL`** — нет; обе ветви требуют одинаковых колонок.
- Дерево (`id`, `p_id`): `Root` — нет родителя, `Inner` — встречается как чей-то родитель, остальные — `Leaf`.
- **`LEAD(...) OVER (PARTITION BY … ORDER BY …)`** даёт следующую строку окна — удобно для пар «соседних» событий.

content.caption: UNION склеивает две выборки, UNION ALL сохраняет дубли
content.description: Анти-джойны в обе стороны находят «дыры» в данных.

content.description:
`bonus` = `salary`, если `employee_id` нечётный **и** `name` не начинается с `M`; иначе `0`. Сортировка по `employee_id`.

[LeetCode 1873](https://leetcode.com/problems/calculate-special-bonus/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Employees(employee_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, salary INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT employee_id, CASE WHEN employee_id % 2 = 1 THEN salary ELSE 0 END AS bonus FROM Employees ORDER BY employee_id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT employee_id, CASE WHEN employee_id % 2 = 1 AND name NOT LIKE 'M%' THEN salary ELSE 0 END AS bonus FROM Employees ORDER BY employee_id;

content.description:
Разверните `Products` в длинный формат: `product_id`, `store` (`store1`/`store2`/`store3`), `price`; строки с `NULL` не выводятся. Сортировка по `product_id`, `store`.

[LeetCode 1795](https://leetcode.com/problems/rearrange-products-table/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Products(product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, store1 INTEGER, store2 INTEGER, store3 INTEGER);
content.starterCode: SELECT product_id, 'store1' AS store, store1 AS price FROM Products;
content.referenceSolution:
SELECT product_id, 'store1' AS store, store1 AS price FROM Products WHERE store1 IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT product_id, 'store2', store2 FROM Products WHERE store2 IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT product_id, 'store3', store3 FROM Products WHERE store3 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY product_id, store;

content.description:
`employee_id` сотрудников, у которых нет `name` **или** нет `salary`. Сортировка по `employee_id`.

[LeetCode 1965](https://leetcode.com/problems/employees-with-missing-information/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Employees(employee_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE Salaries(employee_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, salary INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT employee_id FROM Employees UNION SELECT employee_id FROM Salaries ORDER BY employee_id;

content.description:
Для каждого отдела — сотрудники с **максимальной** зарплатой в нём. Колонки `Department`, `Employee`, `Salary`.

[LeetCode 184](https://leetcode.com/problems/department-highest-salary/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Employee(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, salary INTEGER NOT NULL, departmentId INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE Department(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT d.name AS Department, e.name AS Employee, MAX(e.salary) AS Salary FROM Employee e JOIN Department d ON e.departmentId = d.id GROUP BY d.id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT d.name AS Department, e.name AS Employee, e.salary AS Salary FROM Employee e JOIN Department d ON e.departmentId = d.id WHERE (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e2.salary) FROM Employee e2 WHERE e2.departmentId = e.departmentId AND e2.salary > e.salary) = 0;

content.description:
Для каждого узла `Tree` верните `id` и `type`: `Root` (нет `p_id`), `Inner` (есть потомки), `Leaf`. Сортировка по `id`.

[LeetCode 608](https://leetcode.com/problems/tree-node/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Tree(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, p_id INTEGER);
content.starterCode: SELECT id, CASE WHEN p_id IS NULL THEN 'Leaf' ELSE 'Root' END AS type FROM Tree ORDER BY id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT id, CASE WHEN p_id IS NULL THEN 'Root' WHEN id IN (SELECT DISTINCT p_id FROM Tree WHERE p_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'Inner' ELSE 'Leaf' END AS type FROM Tree ORDER BY id;

content.description:
Пользователи, перешедшие с `free_trial` на `paid`: `user_id`, `trial_avg_duration`, `paid_avg_duration` — средние `activity_duration` за соответствующий период (округлить до 2 знаков). Строки `cancelled` игнорируются. Сортировка по `user_id`.

[LeetCode 3497](https://leetcode.com/problems/analyze-subscription-conversion/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE UserActivity(user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, activity_date TEXT NOT NULL, activity_type TEXT NOT NULL, activity_duration INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT user_id, ROUND(AVG(activity_duration), 2) AS trial_avg_duration, ROUND(AVG(activity_duration), 2) AS paid_avg_duration FROM UserActivity WHERE activity_type <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY user_id;
content.referenceSolution:
WITH t AS (SELECT user_id, activity_type, ROUND(SUM(activity_duration) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS duration FROM UserActivity WHERE activity_type <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY user_id, activity_type)
SELECT f.user_id, f.duration AS trial_avg_duration, p.duration AS paid_avg_duration FROM t f JOIN t p ON f.user_id = p.user_id WHERE f.activity_type = 'free_trial' AND p.activity_type = 'paid' ORDER BY f.user_id;

content.description:
Пары товаров (`product1_id` < `product2_id`), купленные **≥ 3** разными покупателями: колонки `product1_id`, `product2_id`, `product1_category`, `product2_category`, `customer_count`. Сортировка: `customer_count` убыв., затем `product1_id`, `product2_id` возр.

[LeetCode 3521](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-product-recommendation-pairs/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE ProductPurchases(user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(user_id, product_id));
CREATE TABLE ProductInfo(product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, category TEXT NOT NULL, price INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT a.product_id AS product1_id, b.product_id AS product2_id, ai.category AS product1_category, bi.category AS product2_category, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM ProductPurchases a JOIN ProductPurchases b ON a.user_id = b.user_id AND a.product_id < b.product_id JOIN ProductInfo ai ON ai.product_id = a.product_id JOIN ProductInfo bi ON bi.product_id = b.product_id GROUP BY a.product_id, b.product_id ORDER BY customer_count DESC, product1_id, product2_id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT a.product_id AS product1_id, b.product_id AS product2_id, ai.category AS product1_category, bi.category AS product2_category, COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) AS customer_count FROM ProductPurchases a JOIN ProductPurchases b ON a.user_id = b.user_id AND a.product_id < b.product_id JOIN ProductInfo ai ON ai.product_id = a.product_id JOIN ProductInfo bi ON bi.product_id = b.product_id GROUP BY a.product_id, b.product_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) >= 3 ORDER BY customer_count DESC, product1_id, product2_id;

content.description:
Пары **категорий** (`category1` < `category2`), товары из которых покупали **≥ 3** разных покупателя: колонки `category1`, `category2`, `customer_count`. Сортировка: `customer_count` убыв., затем `category1`, `category2` возр.

[LeetCode 3554](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-category-recommendation-pairs/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE ProductPurchases(user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(user_id, product_id));
CREATE TABLE ProductInfo(product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, category TEXT NOT NULL, price INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode:
WITH user_category AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.user_id, i.category FROM ProductPurchases p JOIN ProductInfo i ON p.product_id = i.product_id)
SELECT a.category AS category1, b.category AS category2, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM user_category a JOIN user_category b ON a.user_id = b.user_id AND a.category < b.category GROUP BY a.category, b.category ORDER BY customer_count DESC, category1, category2;
content.referenceSolution:
WITH user_category AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.user_id, i.category FROM ProductPurchases p JOIN ProductInfo i ON p.product_id = i.product_id)
SELECT a.category AS category1, b.category AS category2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) AS customer_count FROM user_category a JOIN user_category b ON a.user_id = b.user_id AND a.category < b.category GROUP BY a.category, b.category HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) >= 3 ORDER BY customer_count DESC, category1, category2;

content.description:
Для «сильных» студентов (≥ 5 курсов и средний `course_rating` ≥ 4) — последовательные пары курсов в порядке `completion_date`: `first_course`, `second_course`, `transition_count`. Сортировка: `transition_count` убыв., затем названия курсов возр.

[LeetCode 3764](https://leetcode.com/problems/most-common-course-pairs/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE course_completions(user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, course_id INTEGER NOT NULL, course_name TEXT NOT NULL, completion_date TEXT NOT NULL, course_rating INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(user_id, course_id));
content.starterCode:
WITH pairs AS (SELECT course_name AS first_course, LEAD(course_name) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY completion_date, course_id) AS second_course FROM course_completions)
SELECT first_course, second_course, COUNT(*) AS transition_count FROM pairs WHERE second_course IS NOT NULL GROUP BY first_course, second_course ORDER BY transition_count DESC, first_course, second_course;
